item.heraliz_composants.canon.desc: Salvaged gun barrel, rifling still sharp.
item.heraliz_composants.ressort.desc: Steel spring, still nice and stiff.
item.heraliz_composants.kit_pieces.desc: Box of small gun parts: screws, pins, springs.
item.heraliz_composants.tissu.desc: Clean cloth, enough for a bandage.
item.heraliz_composants.batterie.desc: Powers scopes, lasers and red dots.
Scope electronics, salvaged from a radio.
item.heraliz_composants.ferraille.desc: A bit of everything, lots of rust.
item.heraliz_composants.bocal_poudre.des: A jar full of black powder.
A keg full of black powder. Keep away from fire.
Rusty sheet scraps held with tape. Better than nothing.
item.heraliz_composants.plaque_soudee.de: Steel offcuts welded together. Starting to hold up.
item.heraliz_composants.plaque_metal.des: A real steel plate, cleanly cut.
item.heraliz_composants.plaque_renforcee: Thick plate with ballistic coating. Top of the line.
item.heraliz_composants.caoutchouc.desc: An old bike tyre. Worth a few coins.
item.heraliz_composants.corde.desc: A few metres of frayed rope.
item.heraliz_composants.planche.desc: A salvaged plank, nails still in.
item.heraliz_composants.collier_casse.de: A broken golden chain with its pendant.
Cracked screen, no battery, no signal.
item.heraliz_composants.montre_cassee.de: Cracked glass, torn strap. Time stopped.
item.heraliz_composants.lunettes_cassees: One cracked lens, one bent arm.
item.heraliz_composants.radio_cassee.des: Old rusty radio, patched with tape. Not a sound.
Burnt out. Like the rest of the world.
item.heraliz_composants.briquet.desc: Old tarnished lighter, the lid is loose. Sparks one time in three.
Military tag on its chain. The name is almost worn off.
item.heraliz_composants.cigarettes.desc: Still full. The real currency of the apocalypse.
item.heraliz_composants.bague_argent.des: A plain silver ring, slightly tarnished.
item.heraliz_composants.amulette.desc: An old silver pendant with a blue stone at its heart.
item.heraliz_composants.bague_fiancaille: Gold and a small diamond, in its box. There is a story behind it.
item.heraliz_composants.appareil_photo.d: Metal body, lens intact. Out of film.
item.heraliz_composants.crucifix.desc: A gold cross on a thin chain. Someone prayed with it.
item.heraliz_composants.lingot_argent.de: A cast, stamped bar. Heavier than it looks.
item.heraliz_composants.chronographe.des: Gold watch, untouched. Used to be worth more than a car.
item.heraliz_composants.collier_perles.d: A full strand of pearls, gold clasp.
item.heraliz_composants.statuette_jade.d: A small elephant carved in jade. Fragile.
item.heraliz_composants.diamant.desc: A cut stone the size of a walnut. Pure madness.
item.heraliz_composants.lingot_or.desc: A kilo of solid gold, stamped. Every looter's dream.
item.heraliz_composants.couronne.desc: Gold, rubies and sapphires. Someone ruled before the end.
item.heraliz_composants.idole_doree.desc: Ancient solid gold statuette. Its ruby eyes follow you.
item.heraliz_composants.oeuf_orne.desc: Enamel and gold, a museum piece. Nobody knows how it got here.
item.heraliz_composants.crane_cristal.de: Carved from a single block of crystal. Nobody dares to look it in the eyes.
item.heraliz_composants.sceptre.desc: Solid gold and a giant sapphire. Power, back when it meant something.
item.heraliz_composants.calice.desc: A relic of gold and gems, taken from a ruined cathedral.
Offcuts of sheet metal and cut bars.
item.heraliz_composants.metal_renforce.d: A thick steel plate, banded and riveted.
